opportunities.name: Mismatch-14 NEEDS-REVIEW lakes (Canyon, Detroit, Jackson, Rend, Taneycomo)
opportunities.waiting: Per lake: Canyon/Jackson - accept the A2W=CDA tsid identity (or log A2W for 20 days); Detroit - accept a day-key-aligned comparison (a new pre-registered criteria version); Taneycomo - supply the FERC P-2221 operating range; Rend - decide on the unexplained 0.55 ft series offset
opportunities.why: every pre-registered criterion passes except one documented gap each

opportunities.name: New provider adapters on the post-hoc rows (CO-OPS, USGS-d, CDEC, USBR PN, NWRFC, CWMS-NWDP)
opportunities.waiting: The R8 decision AND a Swift adapter per provider (CO-OPS alone is 14 rows)
opportunities.why: two blockers each: no adapter and post-hoc

opportunities.name: Flagged single-origin rows (drawdown / weak level class)
opportunities.waiting: An independent second source per lake (corroboration) or a Michael waiver of the R7 'flag' class
opportunities.why: the flag marks rows whose level class or drawdown could not be confirmed

opportunities.name: Coordinate: identity-risk lakes whose evidence is strict (only blocker)
opportunities.waiting: Per-lake identity decision: is the directory pin the lake the gauge belongs to (name or namesake collision)? Michael's call, lake by lake
opportunities.why: the directory point may be a different water body; a wrong match would put another lake's level on the wrong lake

opportunities.name: Provider terms: St. Johns River WMD and NH DES
opportunities.waiting: Written confirmation of acceptable use of the SJRWMD / NH DES public endpoints (or a supported feed), then one adapter per provider
opportunities.why: strict rows exist (3 + 1 in T1) but the endpoint terms are unreviewed; two adapters would unlock the group

opportunities.name: Unbound lakes with a known but stale / portal-only / pending source
opportunities.waiting: Per lake: a live feed (stale), a machine-readable endpoint (portal/PDF/login only) or the pending corroboration / operator full-pool figure
opportunities.why: the only unbound lakes with a named source at all

opportunities.name: Stage-only lakes
opportunities.waiting: A documented gauge datum (USGS site altitude / operator datum record) to turn stage into elevation; never a fitted offset

opportunities.name: Unbound lakes whose live candidate failed the review rules
opportunities.waiting: Per lake: a different candidate series, or a decision on which failed rule is waivable (each failure was a real check: datum, freshness, identity, plausibility)
opportunities.why: a candidate exists but did not pass R1-R8; padding these would be the poor matches the rule forbids

opportunities.name: Provider terms: other undocumented operator endpoints (Duke, SRP, CNPPID, ...)
opportunities.waiting: Operator permission / terms per endpoint (Duke Energy Lake View is the largest: 8 lakes); one adapter per operator
opportunities.why: each operator needs its own agreement and adapter; reuse is low except Duke

opportunities.name: Unbound lakes with no public level data found
opportunities.waiting: A new public data source or a state / local gauge; research logged per-lake dead ends (no gauge, discontinued, proxy only)

opportunities.name: Coordinate: no polygon (22 lakes) whose evidence is strict (only blocker)
opportunities.waiting: A polygon source (NHD/OSM/GSW) accepted by the geometry contract, then the usual pin repair
opportunities.why: cannot be assessed until a polygon exists
